id: title:gantoine:pin the reviewer interpreter in the sandbox

review.posthog_relevance: Stamphog is a PostHog-hosted AI evaluation service; this change hardens the reviewer command against supply-chain and environment-dependent behavior by explicitly resolving and supplying the Python interpreter, while disabling automatic discovery and project configuration.
review.reason: Adds a shell command to resolve the Python interpreter before changing directory, and injects that resolved path into the uv invocation. P1.F1.H3: Defines the shell variable name used for the resolved Python path and updates the command construction to include the resolved interpreter path before the uv run, while also adding no-config and no-project flags. P1.F2.H1: Adds an assert
review.uncertainty: This score is assigned based on the observed implementation of a security and compatibility improvement. However, the actual benefit depends on the existence and configuration of the Stamphog service, which is not independently verified. The score does not account for unverified outcomes or the actual impact on PostHog's operations.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a shell command to resolve the Python interpreter before changing directory, and injects that resolved path into the uv invocation.
observations.posthog_connection: Stamphog is a PostHog-hosted AI evaluation service; this prevents the sandboxed reviewer from discovering an interpreter in the checkout or parent directories, which could execute arbitrary code or use an unexpected Python version. The resolved path is passed to uv to ensure the sandbox uses the caller's supplied interpreter.

observations.behavior: Defines the shell variable name used for the resolved Python path and updates the command construction to include the resolved interpreter path before the uv run, while also adding no-config and no-project flags.
observations.posthog_connection: Stamphog's reviewer command is hardened against supply-chain and environment-dependent behavior. The change explicitly disables uv's automatic discovery and project configuration, and forces the use of a pre-resolved, caller-supplied Python interpreter, reducing the attack surface and compatibility issues.

observations.behavior: Adds an assertion that the resolved Python command appears before the directory change and that the resolved path is passed to uv, while also asserting that the STAMPHOG_REPO_ROOT environment variable is present.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a regression test for the interpreter resolution and no-config behavior, supporting PostHog's reliability and security expectations for the Stamphog service.
